parameters.content:
## E-mail workflow (webhook)
**After import:** bind *Header Auth* (header `X-Webhook-Secret`) to the webhook, *Notion API* to every Notion node and the authorized *Gmail OAuth2* credential to **Gmail send**; set `assessments_db_id`, `errors_db_id` and the fixed approved `recipient` in **Config**.
Flow: validate -> verify the PDF (SHA-256 of the decoded binary) -> check the Notion ledger (`Email status`) -> claim `sending` -> Gmail Send -> record result. One real e-mail only when the Gradio user clicks the button. **The production URL exists only while ACTIVE.**
